316 ground bar Ø20 h8 x 290, M10 tapped 20 deep one end
1. Rods square to the top within 0.2 over 200: fit the bushings with the rods in place and the stage at the shaker stop, then tighten H10.
2. Ream the 4 pin holes after welding the bar so they stay square to the plunger axis; the plunger GN 617-10 needs Ø10 H9 holes.
3. Set the stops on the first build with the real containers: rim 10 [.39] below the tube outlet (GAP 10) at each stop.
4. Nest rings are UHMW-PE turned to each container, held by the 4 M5 screws; one ring per container, kept with the change parts.
